name: Knee — early rehab
for: The first weeks after a knee injury or surgery: swelling down, the quad awake, the bend returning
blurb: Range of motion and the thigh muscle switched back on, within the range your surgeon or physio has set. Two or three times a day.
notes: The first goal after surgery is a knee that straightens fully and bends to ninety degrees; most of daily life needs ninety to one hundred and ten.
The heel slide’s target is the number to move: ninety first, then on toward one hundred and twenty.

sources.title: Range of motion after knee replacement

items.note: To ninety degrees first; the setting goes down as it frees.
A lower lift; the toes are left alone for now.
